text:
How beautiful the sun appears when freshly it rises,

Giving good morning as in an explosion

—Happy the one who can, pierced through by love,

Greet the setting sun, more glorious than a dream.


I remember it!... I have seen everything, flower, furrow, fountain,

Fall beneath its gaze like a living heart...

—Quickly, quickly, it is late, let us go to the horizon

To catch at least some oblique ray.


But in vain I pursue the God who withdraws;

Irresistible Night establishes its empire,

Black, damp, fatal, broken by shivers;


A smell of tombs floats in the darkness,

And my fearful foot brushes, beside the marsh,

Unexpected toads and frozen slugs.

translation.title: Romantic Sunset
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the poem's shift from romantic sunset pursuit into marsh, tomb-smell, and cold creatures.
